title: Chick reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Chick body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='24' ry='20' fill='#FFD93D'/>
  <!-- Chick head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='18' fill='#FFE44D'/>
  <!-- Head highlight -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='15' fill='#FFF176' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Left eye -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='40' r='4' fill='#4A2800'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='39' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Right eye -->
  <circle cx='57' cy='40' r='4' fill='#4A2800'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='39' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Beak -->
  <polygon points='47,48 53,48 50,54' fill='#FF9800'/>
  <polygon points='48,48 52,48 50,51' fill='#FFB74D'/>
  <!-- Wing left (holding book) -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='66' rx='8' ry='12' fill='#FFC107' transform='rotate(-20 30 66)'/>
  <!-- Wing right (holding book) -->
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='66' rx='8' ry='12' fill='#FFC107' transform='rotate(20 70 66)'/>
  <!-- Book left page -->
  <polygon points='32,58 50,62 50,80 32,76' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <polygon points='34,60 49,63.5 49,78 34,74.5' fill='#F5F5F5'/>
  <!-- Book right page -->
  <polygon points='50,62 68,58 68,76 50,80' fill='#EEEEEE'/>
  <polygon points='51,63.5 66,60 66,74.5 51,78' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Book spine -->
  <line x1='50' y1='62' x2='50' y2='80' stroke='#FF8F00' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Book cover edge -->
  <polygon points='32,58 50,62 50,80 32,76' fill='none' stroke='#E65100' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <polygon points='50,62 68,58 68,76 50,80' fill='none' stroke='#E65100' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Text lines on left page -->
  <line x1='36' y1='64' x2='47' y2='66.5' stroke='#90CAF9' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='36' y1='68' x2='47' y2='70.5' stroke='#90CAF9' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='36' y1='72' x2='47' y2='74.5' stroke='#90CAF9' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Text lines on right page -->
  <line x1='53' y1='66.5' x2='64' y2='64' stroke='#90CAF9' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='70.5' x2='64' y2='68' stroke='#90CAF9' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='74.5' x2='64' y2='72' stroke='#90CAF9' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Chick feet -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='88' rx='7' ry='3' fill='#FF9800'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='88' rx='7' ry='3' fill='#FF9800'/>
  <!-- Chick tuft on head -->
  <path d='M48,25 Q50,18 52,25' fill='#FFC107' stroke='#FFD93D' stroke-width='1'/>
  <path d='M46,26 Q48,16 50,24' fill='#FFC107' stroke='#FFD93D' stroke-width='1'/>
  <path d='M50,24 Q52,15 54,25' fill='#FFC107' stroke='#FFD93D' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- Cheek blush -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='47' r='3' fill='#FF8A80' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='47' r='3' fill='#FF8A80' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
